title: Silver Zoom Card: How to Get Fuel Discounts at Participating Stations
summary: This document explains how to use the Silver Zoom Card to get fuel discounts at participating stations in 10 supported fuel networks, including how to confirm participation, present the card, and keep your receipt. Eligible fuel transactions receive a 10.0% reduction/statement adjustment of the fuel subtotal; if it doesn’t appear immediately, it may post after settlement.
